source.sqlReaderQuery: SELECT COUNT(1) CNT FROM D360.STG_EDS_DEP_SETIDTABLE WHERE H = 'D'

scripts.text:
--TRUNCATE TABLE EDS.DEP_SETIDTABLE

TRUNCATE TABLE d360.STG_EDS_DEP_SETIDTABLE_SELECT_SRC;

INSERT INTO d360.STG_EDS_DEP_SETIDTABLE_SELECT_SRC
(
                SET_ID,
                BANK_ID,
                SET_DESC,
                LCHG_USER_ID,
                LCHG_TIME,
                RCRE_USER_ID,
                RCRE_TIME,
                TS_CNT,
                ALT1_SET_DESC,
                RSIS_ALIAS,
                FILE_NAME,
				JSRC_FLG, 
				JTAR_FLG 
)


SELECT 
                SET_ID,
                BANK_ID,
                SET_DESC,
                LCHG_USER_ID,
                LCHG_TIME,
                RCRE_USER_ID,
                RCRE_TIME,
                TS_CNT,
                ALT1_SET_DESC,
                RSIS_ALIAS,
                FILE_NAME,
				1 AS JSRC_FLG, 
				0 AS JTAR_FLG 
			FROM [d360].[STG_EDS_DEP_SETIDTABLE]
            WHERE H = 'D'
                AND CAST(LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME, 12), 8 )AS DATE) >= CAST(RCRE_TIME AS DATE);


INSERT INTO d360.STG_EDS_DEP_SETIDTABLE_SELECT_SRC
(
                SET_ID,
                BANK_ID,
                SET_DESC,
                LCHG_USER_ID,
                LCHG_TIME,
                RCRE_USER_ID,
                RCRE_TIME,
                TS_CNT,
                ALT1_SET_DESC,
                RSIS_ALIAS,
                FILE_NAME, 
				JSRC_FLG, 
				JTAR_FLG 
)
			SELECT 				
                CC.SET_ID,
                CC.BANK_ID,
                CC.SET_DESC,
                CC.LCHG_USER_ID,
                CC.LCHG_TIME,
                CC.RCRE_USER_ID,
                CC.RCRE_TIME,
                CC.TS_CNT,
                CC.ALT1_SET_DESC,
                CC.RSIS_ALIAS,
                CC.FILE_NAME,
		        0 AS JSRC_FLG, 
				1 AS JTAR_FLG 
			FROM EDS.DEP_SETIDTABLE CC
			WHERE CC.ISLATEST = '1';
	


TRUNCATE TABLE d360.STG_EDS_DEP_SETIDTABLE_GROUP_SRC;

INSERT INTO d360.STG_EDS_DEP_SETIDTABLE_GROUP_SRC
(
                SET_ID,
                BANK_ID,
                SET_DESC,
                LCHG_USER_ID,
                LCHG_TIME,
                RCRE_USER_ID,
                RCRE_TIME,
                TS_CNT,
                ALT1_SET_DESC,
                RSIS_ALIAS,
                FILE_NAME, 
				JSRC_FLG_CNT, 
				JTAR_FLG_CNT, 
				FILE_DATE
)

select 
                SET_ID,
                BANK_ID,
                SET_DESC,
                LCHG_USER_ID,
                LCHG_TIME,
                RCRE_USER_ID,
                RCRE_TIME,
                TS_CNT,
                ALT1_SET_DESC,
                RSIS_ALIAS,
				FILE_NAME, 
				JSRC_FLG_CNT, 
				JTAR_FLG_CNT,
				CAST(LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME , 12), 8) AS DATE) FILE_DATE
from 
(
	SELECT 				
                SET_ID,
                BANK_ID,
                SET_DESC,
                LCHG_USER_ID,
                LCHG_TIME,
                RCRE_USER_ID,
                RCRE_TIME,
                TS_CNT,
                ALT1_SET_DESC,
                RSIS_ALIAS,
				MAX(FILE_NAME) FILE_NAME, 
				SUM(JSRC_FLG) AS JSRC_FLG_CNT, 
				SUM(JTAR_FLG) AS JTAR_FLG_CNT
	FROM d360.STG_EDS_DEP_SETIDTABLE_SELECT_SRC
	GROUP BY 					
                SET_ID,
                BANK_ID,
                SET_DESC,
                LCHG_USER_ID,
                LCHG_TIME,
                RCRE_USER_ID,
                RCRE_TIME,
                TS_CNT,
                ALT1_SET_DESC,
                RSIS_ALIAS
	HAVING ( SUM(JSRC_FLG) = 1 AND SUM(JTAR_FLG) = 0 ) OR ( SUM(JSRC_FLG) = 0 AND SUM(JTAR_FLG) = 1) 
) AS TEMP


DECLARE @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY AS DATE
SELECT @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY = PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY FROM EDS.DATE_DIM 
INNER JOIN (SELECT TOP 1 CAST(LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME, 12), 8) AS INTEGER) MX_DT FROM [d360].[STG_EDS_DEP_SETIDTABLE]) MX_DT_TBL
ON DATESK = MX_DT;	


UPDATE A
SET
SCD_END_DATE = @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY
, ISLATEST = 0
FROM EDS.DEP_SETIDTABLE A 
INNER JOIN d360.STG_EDS_DEP_SETIDTABLE_GROUP_SRC B ON
COALESCE(A.SET_ID,'-1') = COALESCE(B.SET_ID,'-1')
AND COALESCE(A.BANK_ID,'-1') = COALESCE(B.BANK_ID,'-1')
AND A.ISLATEST = 1
AND B.JTAR_FLG_CNT = 1


INSERT INTO EDS.DEP_SETIDTABLE
(
                SET_ID,
                BANK_ID,
                SET_DESC,
                LCHG_USER_ID,
                LCHG_TIME,
                RCRE_USER_ID,
                RCRE_TIME,
                TS_CNT,
                ALT1_SET_DESC,
                RSIS_ALIAS,
				SCD_START_DATE, 
				SCD_END_DATE, 
				ISACTIVE, 
				ISLATEST, 
				BNK_CODE, 
				SOURCE_CODE, 
				FILE_NAME, 
				insert_dttm
)
SELECT
                SRC.SET_ID,
                SRC.BANK_ID,
                SRC.SET_DESC,
                SRC.LCHG_USER_ID,
                SRC.LCHG_TIME,
                SRC.RCRE_USER_ID,
                SRC.RCRE_TIME,
                SRC.TS_CNT,
                SRC.ALT1_SET_DESC,
                SRC.RSIS_ALIAS,
				SRC.FILE_DATE,
				'9999-12-31',
				1,
				1,
				SRC.BANK_ID,
				'DEP',
				SRC.FILE_NAME,
				CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
FROM d360.STG_EDS_DEP_SETIDTABLE_GROUP_SRC SRC
WHERE JSRC_FLG_CNT = 1
